c1-oba-0001: Obadiah warns Edom that its own allies will turn on it. Read Obadiah 1:7.
c2-oba-0001: Obadiah lists what Edom should not have done in Judah's day of distress. Read Obadiah 1:12 and Obadiah 1:14.
c2-num-0011: Edom's king refused Israel passage and threatened to come out against them. Read Numbers 20:17 and Numbers 20:19.
c3-num-0005: Edom refused Israel passage, and then came out against them with many men. Read Numbers 20:20 and Numbers 20:21.
c3-oba-0001: Obadiah says Edom will be made small. Then strangers carried Judah's forces captive. Read Obadiah 1:2 and Obadiah 1:11.
c3-oba-0002: The LORD will destroy the wise men from Edom. See what the house of Jacob shall do in Obadiah 1:8 and Obadiah 1:17.
c3-oba-0003: Obadiah condemns Edom for violence against brother Jacob. Jacob is a fire, and Joseph a flame. Read Obadiah 1:10 and Obadiah 1:18.
c3-gen-0012: “Two nations are in your womb,” the LORD told Rebekah. Read Genesis 25:23 and Genesis 36:33.
c1-nah-0001: Amid warnings for Nineveh, Nahum says the LORD is good, a stronghold in trouble. Read Nahum 1:7.
c2-nah-0001: The LORD promised to break the yoke off Judah. Then a messenger brought good tidings. Read Nahum 1:13 and Nahum 1:15.
c2-nah-0002: Nahum compares Nineveh with another great city that had waters around her. Read Nahum 3:8 and Nahum 3:9.
c3-jon-0001: When word reached the king of Nineveh, he laid aside his robe and covered himself with sackcloth. Read Jonah 3:6 and Jonah 3:10.
c3-nah-0001: With an overflowing flood the LORD will make an utter end of Nineveh's place. Read Nahum 1:8 and Nahum 2:6.
c3-nah-0002: Nahum says affliction will not rise up a second time. Then he speaks of Nineveh's injury. Read Nahum 1:9 and Nahum 3:19.
c3-nah-0003: Nahum mocks Nineveh: “Man the fort! Watch the road!” Later the city is told to fortify its strongholds. Read Nahum 2:1 and Nahum 3:14.
c3-jon-0002: God relented toward Nineveh, then asked whether He should not pity that great city. Read Jonah 3:10 and Jonah 4:11.
c1-zep-0001: People swear oaths by the LORD, but they also swear by another. Read Zephaniah 1:5.
c2-zep-0001: The LORD will search Jerusalem closely and punish men who say He will do neither good nor evil. Read Zephaniah 1:12 and Zephaniah 1:13.
c2-zep-0002: The humble of the land are called to seek the LORD, righteousness, and humility. Read Zephaniah 2:2 and Zephaniah 2:3.
c3-zep-0001: Zephaniah says the sanctuary was polluted, and her judges are evening wolves. Read Zephaniah 3:3 and Zephaniah 3:4.
c3-zep-0002: Some had turned back from following the LORD. Then hear what the Mighty One will do in Zephaniah 1:6 and Zephaniah 3:17.
c3-zep-0003: The LORD tells the faithful to wait for Him, for He will gather the nations. Read Zephaniah 2:1 and Zephaniah 3:8.
c3-zep-0004: Nineveh dwelt securely and spoke in her heart. Read Zephaniah 2:15 and Zephaniah 3:1.
c3-zep-0005: The LORD stretches out His hand, and Nineveh becomes a desolation. Read Zephaniah 1:4 and Zephaniah 2:14.
c1-phm-0001: Paul writes to Philemon, but he names other people as well. Read Philemon 1:2.
c2-phm-0001: Paul thanks God for Philemon whenever he prays. Read Philemon 1:4 and Philemon 1:5.
c2-col-0004: Tychicus is coming, and Onesimus is coming with him. Read Colossians 4:7 and Colossians 4:9.
c3-phm-0001: Paul might have been bold enough to command Philemon, but he wanted his consent. Read Philemon 1:8 and Philemon 1:14.
c3-phm-0002: Paul prays that the sharing of Philemon's faith may become effective. Then he writes with confidence in his obedience. Read Philemon 1:6 and Philemon 1:21.
c3-phm-0003: Onesimus departed for a while, and Paul sees a purpose in it. Read Philemon 1:15 and Philemon 1:18.
c3-phm-0004: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, wished to keep Onesimus with him. Read Philemon 1:1 and Philemon 1:13.
c3-phm-0005: As Paul sends Onesimus back, he has a special word about him. Read Philemon 1:4 and Philemon 1:12.
c1-2jn-0001: The Elder wrote to the elect lady and rejoiced greatly at what he found. Read Second John 1:4.
c2-2jn-0001: The Elder says what he writes is nothing new, and then he talks about love. Read Second John 1:2 and Second John 1:6.
c2-2jn-0002: The Elder writes about a visitor who does not bring the doctrine of Christ. Read Second John 1:10 and Second John 1:11.
c3-2jn-0001: The Elder tells readers to look to themselves, so they do not lose what was worked for. Read Second John 1:8 and Second John 1:11.
c3-2jn-0002: Some abide in the doctrine of Christ, and some do not. Hear the greeting in Second John 1:3 and Second John 1:9.
c3-2jn-0003: The elect sister's household sends greetings, yet many deceivers have gone out. Read Second John 1:13 and Second John 1:7.
c1-3jn-0001: The Elder wrote, but one man would not receive him. Read Third John 1:9.
c2-3jn-0001: The man who resists the Elder will not receive the brethren, and he forbids those who wish to. Read Third John 1:8 and Third John 1:10.
c2-3jn-0002: Gaius has been faithful to brethren and to strangers. The Elder talks about sending them on. Read Third John 1:5 and Third John 1:6.
c3-3jn-0001: The Elder commends a man everyone speaks well of, and he adds his own witness. Read Third John 1:11 and Third John 1:12.
c3-3jn-0002: The Elder has no greater joy than hearing that they walk in truth. Then he talks about the traveling brethren. Read Third John 1:4 and Third John 1:7.
c3-3jn-0003: The Elder urges Gaius to imitate the good. He still has many things to write. Read Third John 1:11 and Third John 1:13.
c2-exo-0022: At Sinai the LORD told Israel what they would be if they kept His covenant. Read Exodus 19:6.
c2-2sa-0009: God promises David’s offspring, “he shall be My son.” If he commits iniquity, God will chasten him. Read Second Samuel 7:14 and Second Samuel 7:15.
c3-jer-0013: The new covenant will not be like the one they broke when the LORD led them from Egypt. Read Jeremiah 31:32 and Jeremiah 31:34.
c3-heb-0009: Hebrews explains why a second covenant was needed, and then it quotes Jeremiah's promise. Read Hebrews 8:7 and Hebrews 8:8.
c3-2sa-0009: God reminds David that He has been with him. Then He promises to plant His people. Read Second Samuel 7:9 and Second Samuel 7:10.
c3-gen-0013: The LORD made a covenant with Abram about the land. Earlier He named a sign in His covenant with Noah. Read Genesis 9:12 and Genesis 15:18.
c3-gen-0014: God says the waters shall never again become a flood. Later He speaks His covenant with Abram. Read Genesis 9:15 and Genesis 17:4.
c3-gen-0015: The LORD appeared to Abram and called him to walk before Him. He also spoke of the land He would give. Read Genesis 15:7 and Genesis 17:1.
c3-gen-0016: Abram waited beside the divided sacrifice. Earlier, God named the creatures in His covenant with Noah. Read Genesis 9:10 and Genesis 15:11.
c3-gen-0017: Abram asks how he will know that he will inherit the land. Later God says He will make His covenant with him. Read Genesis 15:8 and Genesis 17:2.
